purpose: Population-prior-centred FEM control (Reviewer 4 C3): material prior centre fixed at the training-split population mean of true E_background instead of the learned per-scene initializer estimate.
note: Material parameters are drawn per scenario template and reused across geometries, so the train and test splits (geometry-level split) share the same E_background marginal; train mean therefore equals test mean. The 18 locked scenes have mean 4592.94 Pa / median 3813.06 Pa.
